```{r}
#data must be on non-log scale

quantiseq <- deconvolute(deconv_data, "quantiseq")

xcell <- deconvolute(deconv_data, "xcell")

epic <- deconvolute(deconv_data, "epic")
```

```{r}
library(immunedeconv)
library(biomaRt)

# Connect to Ensembl Mouse
mart <- useMart("ensembl", dataset = "mmusculus_gene_ensembl")

# Get mapping from Ensembl to MGI
gene_map <- getBM(attributes = c("ensembl_gene_id", "mgi_symbol"),
                  mart = mart)

# Merge with your data
gene_map <- gene_map[!duplicated(gene_map$ensembl_gene_id), ]
update_cpm_data$ensembl_gene_id <- rownames(update_cpm_data)

# Join and replace rownames with MGI symbols
library(dplyr)
update_cpm_data_mgi <- left_join(update_cpm_data, gene_map, by = "ensembl_gene_id")

# Keep only MGI symbol rows
update_cpm_data_mgi <- update_cpm_data_mgi[!is.na(update_cpm_data_mgi$mgi_symbol), ]
rownames(update_cpm_data_mgi) <- update_cpm_data_mgi$mgi_symbol
update_cpm_data_mgi <- update_cpm_data_mgi[, !(colnames(update_cpm_data_mgi) %in% c("ensembl_gene_id", "mgi_symbol"))]


deconv_data_mouse <- 2^(update_cpm_data_mgi)  

# Run mmcp_counter
mmcp_counter <- deconvolute_mouse(deconv_data_mouse, method = "mmcp_counter")

#run base
base <- deconvolute_mouse(deconv_data_mouse, method = "base")
```

```{r}
##PCA for base
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggExtra)

# Drop first column ("cell_type") and make sure the rest are numeric
base_for_pca <- base %>%
  select(-cell_type) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.)))) %>%
  as.data.frame()

# PCA on samples (transpose)
pca_result <- prcomp(t(base_for_pca), scale. = TRUE)

# Convert to data frame and add your existing metadata (same as before)
pca_data <- as.data.frame(pca_result$x)
pca_data$Group  <- update_group          # same approach you used previously
pca_data$Day    <- update_batch_info
pca_data$Sample <- colnames(base_for_pca)

# Variance explained
pca_var <- summary(pca_result)$importance[2, ]
pc1_var <- round(pca_var[1] * 100, 1)
pc2_var <- round(pca_var[2] * 100, 1)

# PCA scatter (same styling/limits you used)
p <- ggplot(pca_data, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Group, shape = Day)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  labs(
    title = "PCA (BASE) labeled by treatment group and day",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", pc1_var, "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", pc2_var, "%)")
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 8)
  )

# Marginal densities (same as before)
p_marginal <- ggMarginal(
  p,
  type = "density",
  groupColour = TRUE,
  groupFill   = TRUE
)

print(p_marginal)
```

```{r}
## PCA for quanTIseq (same style as BASE)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggExtra)

# Optionally drop 'uncharacterized cell'
quantiseq_for_pca <- quantiseq %>%
  filter(cell_type != "T cell CD4+ (non-regulatory)") %>%
  select(-cell_type) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.)))) %>%
  as.data.frame()

# PCA on samples (transpose), same as BASE (scale.=TRUE)
pca_q <- prcomp(t(quantiseq_for_pca), scale. = TRUE)

# Build plotting df + metadata (same fields as your BASE plot)
pca_q_df <- as.data.frame(pca_q$x)
pca_q_df$Group  <- update_group              # same approach you used before
pca_q_df$Day    <- update_batch_info
pca_q_df$Sample <- colnames(quantiseq_for_pca)

# Variance explained
pca_q_var <- summary(pca_q)$importance[2, ]
pc1_q_var <- round(pca_q_var[1] * 100, 1)
pc2_q_var <- round(pca_q_var[2] * 100, 1)

# Scatter + marginal densities (same styling as your BASE plot)
p_q <- ggplot(pca_q_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Group, shape = Day)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  labs(
    title = "PCA (quanTIseq) labeled by treatment group and day",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", pc1_q_var, "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", pc2_q_var, "%)")
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 8)
  )

p_q_marginal <- ggMarginal(
  p_q,
  type = "density",
  groupColour = TRUE,
  groupFill   = TRUE
)

print(p_q_marginal)
```

```{r}
library(reshape2)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Assume mmcp_counter has first column "cell_type" and remaining columns are samples

# 1) Convert to matrix and scale each column to sum to 1
mat <- as.matrix(mmcp_counter[,-1])
mat_frac <- sweep(mat, 2, colSums(mat, na.rm = TRUE), "/")

# 2) Combine back into a dataframe with cell_type
mmcp_frac <- cbind(cell_type = mmcp_counter$cell_type, as.data.frame(mat_frac))

# 3) Reshape to long format
res_long_frac <- melt(mmcp_frac, id.vars = "cell_type",
                      variable.name = "Sample", value.name = "Fraction")

# 4) Plot as stacked bars (fractions)
ggplot(res_long_frac, aes(x = Sample, y = Fraction, fill = cell_type)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  labs(title = "Immune Cell Composition by Sample (mmcp_counter)",
       x = "Sample", y = "Fraction of total abundance") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1),
        legend.key.size = grid::unit(0.3, "cm"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 7))
```

```{r}
library(limma)
library(tibble)
library(dplyr)

# -----------------------
# 1. Prepare matrices
# -----------------------
# Gene expression: log2CPM matrix (genes x samples)
logCPM <- update_cpm_data

# Cell fractions (BASE): convert to matrix with samples as rows
cellfrac <- base %>%
  column_to_rownames("cell_type") %>%
  as.matrix()
cellfrac <- t(cellfrac)   # rows = samples, cols = cell types

# Align sample order
samples <- Reduce(intersect, list(colnames(logCPM), rownames(cellfrac)))
logCPM  <- logCPM[, samples, drop = FALSE]
cellfrac <- cellfrac[samples, , drop = FALSE]

group  <- factor(update_group)[match(samples, colnames(update_cpm_data))]
purity <- as.numeric(update_tumor_purity)[match(samples, colnames(update_cpm_data))]

# Make Vehicle reference
group <- relevel(group, ref = "Vehicle")

# -----------------------
# 2. Build design matrices
# -----------------------

# WITH tumor purity
design_with <- model.matrix(~ 0 + group + cellfrac + purity)
colnames(design_with) <- make.names(colnames(design_with))

#withour purity and immune cell composition
design_wo <- model.matrix(~ 0 + group)
# WITHOUT tumor purity
#design_wo <- model.matrix(~ 0 + group + cellfrac)
colnames(design_wo) <- make.names(colnames(design_wo))

# -----------------------
# 3. Fit limma models
# -----------------------
fit_w  <- lmFit(logCPM, design_with)
fit_wo <- lmFit(logCPM, design_wo)

# -----------------------
# 4. Contrasts for treatment effects
# -----------------------
contr_with <- makeContrasts(
  AntiPD1_vs_Vehicle   = groupAnti.PD.1      - groupVehicle,
  EPAT_vs_Vehicle      = groupEPAT           - groupVehicle,
  Combo_vs_Vehicle     = groupAnti.PD.1.EPAT - groupVehicle,
  AntiPD1_vs_EPAT      = groupAnti.PD.1      - groupEPAT,
  levels = design_with
)

contr_wo <- makeContrasts(
  AntiPD1_vs_Vehicle   = groupAnti.PD.1      - groupVehicle,
  EPAT_vs_Vehicle      = groupEPAT           - groupVehicle,
  Combo_vs_Vehicle     = groupAnti.PD.1.EPAT - groupVehicle,
  AntiPD1_vs_EPAT      = groupAnti.PD.1      - groupEPAT,
  levels = design_wo
)

fit_wc  <- eBayes(contrasts.fit(fit_w,  contr_with), robust = TRUE)
fit_woc <- eBayes(contrasts.fit(fit_wo, contr_wo),   robust = TRUE)

# -----------------------
# 5. Extract results
# -----------------------
res_with_AntiPD1_vs_Vehicle <- topTable(fit_wc, coef = "AntiPD1_vs_Vehicle", number = Inf)
res_wo_AntiPD1_vs_Vehicle   <- topTable(fit_woc, coef = "AntiPD1_vs_Vehicle", number = Inf)

# Similarly:
# res_with_EPAT_vs_Vehicle   <- topTable(fit_wc, "EPAT_vs_Vehicle", number = Inf)
# res_wo_EPAT_vs_Vehicle     <- topTable(fit_woc, "EPAT_vs_Vehicle", number = Inf)
# ...

```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

plot_volcano <- function(res, title) {
  res$CellType <- rownames(res)
  ggplot(res, aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(adj.P.Val))) +
    geom_point(aes(color = adj.P.Val < 0.05)) +
    geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(adj.P.Val < 0.05, CellType, "")),
              vjust = 1.5, size = 3) +
    labs(title = title, x = "log2 Fold Change", y = "-log10 FDR") +
    theme_minimal()
}

plot_volcano(res_with, "Anti-PD-1 vs Vehicle (With Purity)")
plot_volcano(res_without, "Anti-PD-1 vs Vehicle (Without Purity)")


# Collect all contrasts
logfc_with <- fit_wc$coefficients
logfc_without <- fit_woc$coefficients

library(pheatmap)

pheatmap(logfc_with, main = "logFC (With Purity)",
         scale = "row", cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_cols = FALSE)
pheatmap(logfc_without, main = "logFC (Without Purity)",
         scale = "row", cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_cols = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# ===== 0) Libraries =====
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(reshape2)
library(ggplot2)
library(rstatix)    # pairwise_wilcox_test, kruskal_test (optional)
library(ggpubr)     # stat_pvalue_manual
library(ggforce)    # facet_wrap_paginate

# Assumes:
# - 'base' = wide matrix/data.frame with first column 'cell_type' and other columns as samples
# - 'update_group' = vector of group labels for columns of 'base' (excluding 'cell_type')

# ===== 1) Long-format data with group labels =====
base_long <- melt(base, id.vars = "cell_type",
                  variable.name = "Sample", value.name = "Score")

sample_df <- data.frame(
  Sample = colnames(base)[-1],
  Group  = update_group,
  check.names = FALSE
)

base_long <- merge(base_long, sample_df, by = "Sample")

# Order groups (Vehicle first)
base_long$Group <- factor(
  base_long$Group,
  levels = c("Vehicle", "Anti-PD-1", "EPAT", "Anti-PD-1+EPAT")
)

# ===== 2) (Optional) Overall Kruskal–Wallis per cell type =====
kw <- base_long %>%
  group_by(cell_type) %>%
  kruskal_test(Score ~ Group) %>%
  mutate(q = p.adjust(p, "BH"))

# ===== 3) Pairwise Wilcoxon: ONLY vs Vehicle within each cell type =====
pw_vehicle <- base_long %>%
  group_by(cell_type) %>%
  pairwise_wilcox_test(Score ~ Group, p.adjust.method = "BH") %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  # keep only comparisons where one side is Vehicle
  filter(group1 == "Vehicle" | group2 == "Vehicle") %>%
  # ensure Vehicle is always group1 for clean bracket placement
  mutate(
    group1 = ifelse(group1 == "Vehicle", group1, group2),
    group2 = ifelse(group1 == "Vehicle", group2, group1)
  )

# Keep only significant pairs for annotation (change threshold if desired)
pw_sig <- pw_vehicle %>%
  filter(!is.na(p.adj) & p.adj < 0.05)

# ===== 4) Annotation y-positions (respect fixed ylim [-2, 2]) =====
start_y <- 1.8
step_y  <- 0.12

ann <- pw_sig %>%
  group_by(cell_type) %>%
  arrange(p.adj) %>%
  mutate(
    y.position = start_y + (row_number() - 1) * step_y,
    label = p.adj.signif
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(cell_type, group1, group2, y.position, p, p.adj, p.adj.signif, label)

library(ggforce)

# Page 1
p1 <- ggplot(base_long, aes(x = Group, y = Score, fill = Group)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.6) +
  facet_wrap_paginate(~ cell_type, scales = "free_y", ncol = 4, nrow = 2, page = 1) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-2, 2)) +
  labs(
    title = "BASE — Cell-type enrichment scores (Page 1 of 2)",
    x = "Treatment group", y = "Enrichment score"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.text = element_text(size = 7)  # smaller facet titles
  )

if (nrow(ann) > 0) {
  p1 <- p1 + stat_pvalue_manual(
    data = ann,
    label = "label",
    tip.length = 0.01,
    bracket.size = 0.35,
    hide.ns = TRUE
  )
}

# Page 2
p2 <- ggplot(base_long, aes(x = Group, y = Score, fill = Group)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.6) +
  facet_wrap_paginate(~ cell_type, scales = "free_y", ncol = 4, nrow = 2, page = 2) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-2, 2)) +
  labs(
    title = "BASE — Cell-type enrichment scores (Page 2 of 2)",
    x = "Treatment group", y = "Enrichment score"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.text = element_text(size = 8)  # smaller facet titles
  )

if (nrow(ann) > 0) {
  p2 <- p2 + stat_pvalue_manual(
    data = ann,
    label = "label",
    tip.length = 0.01,
    bracket.size = 0.35,
    hide.ns = TRUE
  )
}

# Render
p1
p2
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

# assume base_long has: cell_type, Sample, Score, Group
comparisons <- setdiff(unique(base_long$Group), "Vehicle")

# loop over all cell types and all comparisons vs Vehicle
pvals <- base_long %>%
  group_by(cell_type) %>%
  group_modify(~{
    v <- .x$Score[.x$Group == "Vehicle"]
    out <- lapply(comparisons, function(g){
      x <- .x$Score[.x$Group == g]
      p <- tryCatch(wilcox.test(x, v, exact = FALSE)$p.value,
                    error = function(e) NA_real_)
      data.frame(Comparison = paste(g, "vs Vehicle"), p_value = p)
    })
    do.call(rbind, out)
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

pvals
```

```{r}
library(reshape2)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# ---- 1) Prepare quantiseq results ----
# Assume quantiseq result is in a data.frame called `quantiseq`
# Format: first column = "cell_type", remaining columns = samples
# Example: rows = B cell, CD8 T cell, NK cell, etc.

quantiseq_long <- melt(quantiseq, id.vars = "cell_type",
                       variable.name = "Sample", value.name = "Fraction")

# Add treatment group info
sample_df <- data.frame(Sample = colnames(quantiseq)[-1],
                        Group  = update_group,
                        check.names = FALSE)

quantiseq_long <- merge(quantiseq_long, sample_df, by = "Sample")

# ---- 2) Plot box & whisker plots ----
ggplot(quantiseq_long, aes(x = Group, y = Fraction, fill = Group)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.6) +
  facet_wrap(~ cell_type, ncol = 3, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  labs(title = "Immune cell fractions (quanTIseq)",
       x = "Treatment group", y = "Cell fraction") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "none")
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# 1) Long format + attach groups
qs_long <- quantiseq %>%
  rename(cell_type = 1) %>%                 # first column is the cell type name
  pivot_longer(-cell_type, names_to = "Sample", values_to = "Score") %>%
  mutate(Sample = as.character(Sample))

sample_df <- data.frame(
  Sample = colnames(quantiseq)[-1],
  Group  = update_group,
  check.names = FALSE
)

qs_long <- qs_long %>%
  inner_join(sample_df, by = "Sample") %>%
  mutate(Group = factor(Group,
                        levels = c("Vehicle","Anti-PD-1","EPAT","Anti-PD-1+EPAT")))

# 2) Define comparisons vs Vehicle
comparisons <- setdiff(levels(qs_long$Group), "Vehicle")

# 3) Per–cell type Wilcoxon tests (fractions can be used directly)
pvals_qs <- qs_long %>%
  group_by(cell_type) %>%
  group_modify(~{
    v <- .x$Score[.x$Group == "Vehicle"]
    out <- lapply(comparisons, function(g){
      x <- .x$Score[.x$Group == g]
      p <- tryCatch(wilcox.test(x, v, exact = FALSE)$p.value,
                    error = function(e) NA_real_)
      data.frame(Comparison = paste(g, "vs Vehicle"), p_value = p)
    })
    bind_rows(out)
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    FDR = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),
    sig = case_when(
      is.na(p_value)   ~ "",
      p_value < 1e-4   ~ "****",
      p_value < 1e-3   ~ "***",
      p_value < 1e-2   ~ "**",
      p_value < 5e-2   ~ "*",
      TRUE             ~ "ns"
    )
  )

# 4) View only significant (p < 0.05)
pvals_qs_sig <- pvals_qs %>%
  filter(!is.na(p_value), p_value < 0.05) %>%
  arrange(cell_type, p_value) %>%
  select(cell_type, Comparison, p_value, sig)

pvals_qs_sig
```

```{r}
# # ---- 0) Libraries ----
library(dplyr)
library(reshape2)
library(ggplot2)
library(rstatix)
library(ggpubr)
library(ggforce)

to_drop <- c("T cell CD4+ (non-regulatory)")
quantiseq_f <- quantiseq %>% dplyr::filter(!cell_type %in% to_drop)

# ---- 1) Long-format + group labels ----
quantiseq_long <- melt(quantiseq_f, id.vars = "cell_type",
                       variable.name = "Sample", value.name = "Fraction")

sample_df <- data.frame(
  Sample = colnames(quantiseq)[-1],
  Group  = update_group,    # <-- make sure this matches order of columns
  check.names = FALSE
)

quantiseq_long <- merge(quantiseq_long, sample_df, by = "Sample")

# Order groups (Vehicle first)
quantiseq_long$Group <- factor(
  quantiseq_long$Group,
  levels = c("Vehicle", "Anti-PD-1", "EPAT", "Anti-PD-1+EPAT")
)

# ---- 2) Stats ----
kw <- quantiseq_long %>%
  group_by(cell_type) %>%
  kruskal_test(Fraction ~ Group) %>%
  mutate(q = p.adjust(p, "BH"))

pw_vehicle <- quantiseq_long %>%
  group_by(cell_type) %>%
  pairwise_wilcox_test(Fraction ~ Group, p.adjust.method = "BH") %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(group1 == "Vehicle" | group2 == "Vehicle") %>%
  mutate(
    group1 = ifelse(group1 == "Vehicle", group1, group2),
    group2 = ifelse(group1 == "Vehicle", group2, group1)
  )

pw_sig <- pw_vehicle %>% filter(!is.na(p.adj) & p.adj < 0.05)

# annotation positions for fractions in [0,1]
start_y <- 0.9
step_y  <- 0.04
ann <- pw_sig %>%
  group_by(cell_type) %>%
  arrange(p.adj) %>%
  mutate(
    y.position = start_y + (row_number() - 1) * step_y,
    label = p.adj.signif
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# ---- 3) Plots ----
# --- compute per-facet y positions for brackets (free_y) ---
facet_tops <- quantiseq_long %>%
  group_by(cell_type) %>%
  summarise(ymax = max(Fraction, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    ymax    = ifelse(is.finite(ymax) & ymax > 0, ymax, 1e-6),
    start_y = ymax * 1.05,      # push higher above whiskers
    step_y  = pmax(ymax * 0.08, 0.02)  # more spacing
  )

ann <- pw_sig %>%
  left_join(facet_tops, by = "cell_type") %>%
  group_by(cell_type) %>%
  arrange(p.adj) %>%
  mutate(
    y.position = start_y + (row_number() - 1) * step_y,
    label = p.adj.signif
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


# --- Page 1 (same format as your top plot, with significance) ---
p1 <- ggplot(quantiseq_long, aes(x = Group, y = Fraction, fill = Group)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.6) +
  ggforce::facet_wrap_paginate(~ cell_type, ncol = 3, nrow = 2, scales = "free_y", page = 1) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  labs(title = "Immune cell fractions (quanTIseq)",
       x = "Treatment group", y = "Cell fraction") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "none")

if (nrow(ann) > 0) {
  p1 <- p1 + ggpubr::stat_pvalue_manual(
    data = ann,
    label = "label",
    tip.length = 0.01,
    bracket.size = 0.35,
    hide.ns = TRUE
  )
}

# --- Page 2 (same format) ---
p2 <- ggplot(quantiseq_long, aes(x = Group, y = Fraction, fill = Group)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.6) +
  ggforce::facet_wrap_paginate(~ cell_type, ncol = 3, nrow = 2, scales = "free_y", page = 2) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  labs(title = "Immune cell fractions (quanTIseq)",
       x = "Treatment group", y = "Cell fraction") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "none")

if (nrow(ann) > 0) {
  p2 <- p2 + ggpubr::stat_pvalue_manual(
    data = ann,
    label = "label",
    tip.length = 0.01,
    bracket.size = 0.35,
    hide.ns = TRUE
  )
}

p1
p2
```

```{r}
#base p-value distribution
library(ggplot2)

# Extract p-values
pvals_with <- res_with_AntiPD1_vs_Vehicle$P.Value
pvals_wo   <- res_wo_AntiPD1_vs_Vehicle$P.Value

# Combine into one data frame
df_p <- data.frame(
  pval = c(pvals_with, pvals_wo),
  Model = rep(c("With purity", "Without purity and BASE"),
              c(length(pvals_with), length(pvals_wo)))
)

# Anti-PD-1 vs Vehicle Histogram of p-values
ggplot(df_p, aes(x = pval, fill = Model)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, alpha = 0.6, position = "identity") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  labs(title = "P-value distribution (Anti-PD-1 vs Vehicle) - BASE",
       x = "P-value", y = "Count") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("steelblue", "tomato"))

## EPAT vs Vehicle
res_with_EPAT    <- topTable(fit_wc,  coef = "EPAT_vs_Vehicle",    number = Inf)
res_without_EPAT <- topTable(fit_woc, coef = "EPAT_vs_Vehicle",    number = Inf)

pvals_with_EPAT <- res_with_EPAT$P.Value
pvals_wo_EPAT   <- res_without_EPAT$P.Value

df_p_EPAT <- data.frame(
  pval  = c(pvals_with_EPAT, pvals_wo_EPAT),
  Model = c(rep("With purity",    length(pvals_with_EPAT)),
            rep("Without purity and BASE", length(pvals_wo_EPAT)))
)

  geom_histogram(bins = 30, alpha = 0.6, position = "identity") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  labs(title = "P-value distribution (EPAT vs Vehicle) - BASE",
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

plot_volcano_with <- function(res_with, title_text) {
  res <- res_with
  res$CellType <- rownames(res)

  res$Significance <- "Middle"
  res$Significance[res$logFC > 0.585 & res$P.Value < 0.05] <- "Up"
  res$Significance[res$logFC < -0.585 & res$P.Value < 0.05] <- "Down"

  ggplot(res, aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(P.Value), color = Significance)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-0.585, 0.585), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Up"="red", "Down"="blue", "Middle"="grey")) +
    labs(title = title_text,
         x = "log2 Fold Change",
         y = "-log10 P-value") +
    xlim(-5, 5) +
    ylim(0, 6) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
}


## Anti-PD-1 vs Vehicle
plot_volcano_with(res_with_AntiPD1_vs_Vehicle,
                  "Volcano: Anti-PD-1 vs Vehicle (BASE, with purity)")

## EPAT vs Vehicle
plot_volcano_with(res_with_EPAT,
                  "Volcano: EPAT vs Vehicle (BASE, with purity)")

## Anti-PD-1 + EPAT vs Vehicle
plot_volcano_with(res_with_Comb,
                  "Volcano: Anti-PD-1 + EPAT vs Vehicle (BASE, with purity)")

## Anti-PD-1 + EPAT vs EPAT
plot_volcano_with(res_with_Combo_vs_EPAT,
                  "Volcano: Anti-PD-1 + EPAT vs EPAT (BASE, with purity)")

## Anti-PD-1 vs EPAT
plot_volcano_with(res_with_AntiPD1_vs_EPAT,
                  "Volcano: Anti-PD-1 vs EPAT (BASE, with purity)")

## Anti-PD-1 + EPAT vs Anti-PD-1
plot_volcano_with(res_with_Combo_vs_AntiPD1,
                  "Volcano: Anti-PD-1 + EPAT vs Anti-PD-1 (BASE, with purity)")
```

```{r}
plot_volcano_highlights <- function(
  res_with,
  title_text,
  anti_ids,
  neg_ids,
  anti_color = "#E69F00",  # positive control
  neg_color  = "#56B4E9",  # negative control
  other_color = "grey80",
  point_size = 2,
  alpha = 0.7,
  xlim_vals = c(-5, 5),
  ylim_vals = c(0, 6)
) {
  res <- res_with

  # Ensure a GeneID column
  if ("ensembl_gene_id" %in% colnames(res)) {
    res$GeneID <- res$ensembl_gene_id
  } else {
    res$GeneID <- rownames(res)
  }

  # Base plot with background points
  p <- ggplot(res, aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(P.Value))) +
    geom_point(color = other_color, size = point_size, alpha = alpha) +
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      x = "log2 Fold Change",
      y = "-log10 P-value"
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = xlim_vals, ylim = ylim_vals, expand = FALSE) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13)

  # Negative control (drawn first)
  p <- p + geom_point(
    data = subset(res, GeneID %in% neg_ids),
    aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(P.Value)),
    color = neg_color,
    size = point_size + 0.8,
    alpha = 0.9
  )

  # Positive control (drawn last → always on top)
  p <- p + geom_point(
    data = subset(res, GeneID %in% anti_ids),
    aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(P.Value)),
    color = anti_color,
    size = point_size + 1.0,
    alpha = 1
  )

  p
}

plot_volcano_highlights(
  res_with_Comb,
  "Volcano: Anti-PD-1 + EPAT vs Vehicle (BASE, with purity)",
  anti_ids = antiPD1_ids,
  neg_ids  = random_neg32$ensembl_gene_id
)
## Example
plot_volcano_highlights(
  res_with_AntiPD1_vs_Vehicle,
  "Volcano: Anti-PD-1 vs Vehicle (BASE,with purity)",
  anti_ids = antiPD1_ids,
  neg_ids  = random_neg32$ensembl_gene_id
)

plot_volcano_highlights(
  res_with_EPAT,
  "Volcano: EPAT vs Vehicle (BASE, with purity)",
  anti_ids = antiPD1_ids,
  neg_ids  = random_neg32$ensembl_gene_id
)
plot_volcano_highlights(
  res_with_Combo_vs_AntiPD1,
  "Volcano: Anti-PD-1 + EPAT vs Anti-PD-1 (BASE, with purity)",
  anti_ids = antiPD1_ids,
  neg_ids  = random_neg32$ensembl_gene_id
)
plot_volcano_highlights(
  res_with_Combo_vs_EPAT,
  "Volcano: Anti-PD-1 + EPAT vs EPAT (BASE, with purity)",
  anti_ids = antiPD1_ids,
  neg_ids  = random_neg32$ensembl_gene_id
)
plot_volcano_highlights(
  res_with_AntiPD1_vs_EPAT,
  "Volcano: Anti-PD-1 vs EPAT (BASE, with purity)",
  anti_ids = antiPD1_ids,
  neg_ids  = random_neg32$ensembl_gene_id
)
```

```{r}
# --- Base WITHOUT purity: highlight-only volcano (pos vs neg controls) ---
plot_volcano_wo_highlights <- function(
  res_wo,
  title_text,
  anti_ids,
  neg_ids,
  anti_color = "#E69F00",  # positive control
  neg_color  = "#56B4E9",  # negative control
  other_color = "grey80",
  point_size = 2,
  alpha = 0.7,
  xlim_vals = c(-5, 5),
  ylim_vals = c(0, 6),
  pval_cut = 0.05,
  lfc_cut  = 0.585
) {
  res <- res_wo

  # Ensure a GeneID column
  if ("ensembl_gene_id" %in% colnames(res)) {
    res$GeneID <- res$ensembl_gene_id
  } else {
    res$GeneID <- rownames(res)
  }

  p <- ggplot(res, aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(P.Value))) +
    # background
    geom_point(color = other_color, size = point_size, alpha = alpha) +
    # thresholds
    labs(title = title_text, x = "log2 Fold Change", y = "-log10 P-value") +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = xlim_vals, ylim = ylim_vals, expand = FALSE) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")

  # draw negatives first
  p <- p + geom_point(
    data = subset(res, GeneID %in% neg_ids),
    aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(P.Value)),
    color = neg_color, size = point_size + 0.8, alpha = 0.9
  )

  # draw positives last (on top)
  p <- p + geom_point(
    data = subset(res, GeneID %in% anti_ids),
    aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(P.Value)),
    color = anti_color, size = point_size + 1.0, alpha = 1
  )

  p
}
## Anti-PD-1 + EPAT vs Vehicle
```

```{r}
  }

  res$Significance <- "Middle"
  res$Significance[res$logFC >  0.585 & res$P.Value < 0.05] <- "Up"
  res$Significance[res$logFC < -0.585 & res$P.Value < 0.05] <- "Down"

  # Which points to highlight
  res$Highlight <- if (!is.null(highlight_ids)) res$GeneID %in% highlight_ids else FALSE

  p <- ggplot(res, aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(P.Value), color = Significance)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
    # overlay highlighted points on top in a single consistent color
    geom_point(
      data = subset(res, Highlight),
      aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(P.Value)),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = 2.6,
      color = highlight_color,
      alpha = 0.95
    ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-0.585, 0.585), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Up"="red", "Down"="blue", "Middle"="grey")) +
    labs(title = title_text,
         x = "log2 Fold Change",
         y = "-log10 P-value") +
    xlim(-5, 5) +
    ylim(0, 6) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")

  p
}

## Example usage for Anti-PD-1 vs Vehicle (with purity)
plot_volcano_with(
  res_with_AntiPD1_vs_Vehicle,
  "Volcano: Anti-PD-1 vs Vehicle (with purity, highlighted set)",
  highlight_ids = antiPD1_ids
)

## If you want to apply the same highlight set to the other contrasts:
plot_volcano_with(res_with_EPAT,
                  "Volcano: EPAT vs Vehicle (BASE, with purity)",
                  highlight_ids = antiPD1_ids)
plot_volcano_with(res_with_Comb,
                  "Volcano: Anti-PD-1 + EPAT vs Vehicle (BASE, with purity)",
                  highlight_ids = antiPD1_ids)
plot_volcano_with(res_with_Combo_vs_EPAT,

plot_volcano_with(res_with_AntiPD1_vs_EPAT,

plot_volcano_with(res_with_Combo_vs_AntiPD1,
                  "Volcano: Anti-PD-1 + EPAT vs Anti-PD-1 (BASE, with purity)",
                  highlight_ids = antiPD1_ids)
```

```{r}
#Base without purity and highlight PD-1 upregulated genes
plot_volcano_wo <- function(res_wo, title_text, highlight_ids = NULL, highlight_color = "#E69F00") {
  res <- res_wo

  # Determine gene ID source
  if ("ensembl_gene_id" %in% colnames(res)) {
    res$GeneID <- res$ensembl_gene_id
  } else {
    res$GeneID <- rownames(res)
  }
  res$CellType <- rownames(res)

  # Significance classes (for background coloring)
  res$Significance <- "Middle"
  res$Significance[res$logFC >  0.585 & res$P.Value < 0.05] <- "Up"
  res$Significance[res$logFC < -0.585 & res$P.Value < 0.05] <- "Down"

  # Mark highlights
  res$Highlight <- if (!is.null(highlight_ids)) res$GeneID %in% highlight_ids else FALSE

  ggplot(res, aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(P.Value), color = Significance)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
    # overlay highlighted genes on top in one color
    geom_point(
      data = subset(res, Highlight),
      aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(P.Value)),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = 2.6,
      color = highlight_color,
      alpha = 0.95
    ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-0.585, 0.585), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Up"="red", "Down"="blue", "Middle"="grey")) +
    labs(title = title_text,
         x = "log2 Fold Change",
         y = "-log10 P-value") +
    xlim(-5, 5) +
    ylim(0, 6) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
}

# Volcano plots (without purity) with highlights
```

```{r}
#quantiseq 
library(limma)
library(tibble)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# -----------------------
# 1) Prepare matrices (quantiseq instead of base)
# -----------------------
# Gene expression: log2CPM matrix (genes x samples)
logCPM <- human_gene

# remove the last row by name (safer than relying on position)
quantiseq_nounc <- quantiseq %>%
  dplyr::filter(cell_type != "uncharacterized cell")

# build cell-fraction matrix (rows = samples, cols = cell types)
cellfrac_q <- quantiseq_new %>%
  column_to_rownames("cell_type") %>%
  as.matrix()
cellfrac_q <- t(cellfrac_q)  # rows = samples, cols = cell types

# Align sample order across all inputs
samples <- Reduce(intersect, list(colnames(human_gene), rownames(cellfrac_q)))
logCPM      <- human_gene[, samples, drop = FALSE]
cellfrac_q  <- cellfrac_q[samples, , drop = FALSE]

group  <- factor(update_group)[match(samples, colnames(update_cpm_data))]
purity <- as.numeric(update_tumor_purity)[match(samples, colnames(update_cpm_data))]

# Vehicle as reference
group <- relevel(group, ref = "Vehicle")

# (Optional but recommended if fractions sum to 1) Drop one col to avoid exact collinearity
# cellfrac_q <- cellfrac_q[, -ncol(cellfrac_q), drop = FALSE]

# -----------------------
# 2) Build design matrices (WITH and WITHOUT purity)
# -----------------------
design_with_q <- model.matrix(~ 0 + group + cellfrac_q + purity)
colnames(design_with_q) <- make.names(colnames(design_with_q))

design_wo_q <- model.matrix(~ 0 + group + cellfrac_q)
colnames(design_wo_q) <- make.names(colnames(design_wo_q))

# -----------------------
# 3) Fit limma models
# -----------------------
fit_w_q  <- lmFit(logCPM, design_with_q)
fit_wo_q <- lmFit(logCPM, design_wo_q)

# -----------------------
# 4) Contrasts for all six comparisons
# -----------------------
contr_with_q <- makeContrasts(
  AntiPD1_vs_Vehicle   = groupAnti.PD.1      - groupVehicle,
  EPAT_vs_Vehicle      = groupEPAT           - groupVehicle,
  Combo_vs_Vehicle     = groupAnti.PD.1.EPAT - groupVehicle,
  Combo_vs_AntiPD1     = groupAnti.PD.1.EPAT - groupAnti.PD.1,
  AntiPD1_vs_EPAT      = groupAnti.PD.1      - groupEPAT,
  Combo_vs_EPAT        = groupAnti.PD.1.EPAT - groupEPAT,
  levels = design_with_q
)
fit_wc_q <- eBayes(contrasts.fit(fit_w_q, contr_with_q), robust = TRUE)

contr_wo_q <- makeContrasts(
  AntiPD1_vs_Vehicle   = groupAnti.PD.1      - groupVehicle,
  EPAT_vs_Vehicle      = groupEPAT           - groupVehicle,
  Combo_vs_Vehicle     = groupAnti.PD.1.EPAT - groupVehicle,
  Combo_vs_AntiPD1     = groupAnti.PD.1.EPAT - groupAnti.PD.1,
  AntiPD1_vs_EPAT      = groupAnti.PD.1      - groupEPAT,
  Combo_vs_EPAT        = groupAnti.PD.1.EPAT - groupEPAT,
  levels = design_wo_q
)
fit_woc_q <- eBayes(contrasts.fit(fit_wo_q, contr_wo_q), robust = TRUE)

# -----------------------
# 5) Helper to plot p-value histograms
# -----------------------
plot_pval_hist <- function(fit_with, fit_wo, coef_name, title_text) {
  res_with <- topTable(fit_with, coef = coef_name, number = Inf)
  res_wo   <- topTable(fit_wo,   coef = coef_name, number = Inf)
  df_p <- data.frame(
    pval  = c(res_with$P.Value, res_wo$P.Value),
    Model = c(rep("With purity",    nrow(res_with)),
              rep("Without purity and quanTIseq", nrow(res_wo)))
  )
  ggplot(df_p, aes(x = pval, fill = Model)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 30, alpha = 0.6, position = "identity") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    labs(title = title_text, x = "P-value", y = "Count") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("steelblue", "tomato"))
}

# -----------------------
# 6) Draw all six distributions
# -----------------------
# Pairwise between treatments
plot_pval_hist(fit_wc_q, fit_woc_q, "Combo_vs_AntiPD1",
               "P-value distribution (Anti-PD-1 + EPAT vs Anti-PD-1) - quantiseq")

plot_pval_hist(fit_wc_q, fit_woc_q, "AntiPD1_vs_EPAT",
               "P-value distribution (Anti-PD-1 vs EPAT) - quantiseq")

plot_pval_hist(fit_wc_q, fit_woc_q, "Combo_vs_EPAT",
               "P-value distribution (Anti-PD-1 + EPAT vs EPAT) - quantiseq")

# Each group vs Vehicle
plot_pval_hist(fit_wc_q, fit_woc_q, "AntiPD1_vs_Vehicle",
               "P-value distribution (Anti-PD-1 vs Vehicle) - quantiseq")

plot_pval_hist(fit_wc_q, fit_woc_q, "EPAT_vs_Vehicle",
               "P-value distribution (EPAT vs Vehicle) - quantiseq")

plot_pval_hist(fit_wc_q, fit_woc_q, "Combo_vs_Vehicle",
               "P-value distribution (Anti-PD-1 + EPAT vs Vehicle) - quantiseq")



```

```{r}
#quantiseq with purity highlight Anti-PD-1 upregulated genes
library(ggplot2)

# Human gene symbols to highlight (as provided)
antiPD1_positive_genes <- c(
  "Cd44", "Chuk", "Cxcl12", "Ebi3", "Ifnar1", "Ifng", "Ikbkb", "Ikbkg",
  "Il12b", "Il18", "Il1b", "Il2", "Il27", "Il6", "Irf3", "Irf7",
  "Itk", "Nfkbia", "Nos2", "Rela", "Spi1", "Stat1", "Tlr4", "Tlr7",
  "Tnf", "Tnfsf10", "Cd28", "Irf1", "Myd88", "Tbx21", "Tlr3", "Cxcl10"
)
#negative control 
#antiPD1_positive_genes <- random_neg32$external_gene_name
# quanTIseq: WITH purity volcano plotter w/ highlight by human gene symbol
plot_volcano_with_qs <- function(res_with, title_text,
                                 highlight_symbols,
                                 symbol_col = "gene_symbol",
                                 highlight_color = "#E69F00") {
  res <- res_with

  # Determine gene symbol source; fall back to rownames
  if (symbol_col %in% colnames(res)) {
    res$GeneSym <- res[[symbol_col]]
  } else {
    res$GeneSym <- rownames(res)
  }

  # Normalize for case-insensitive matching
  res$.sym_norm <- tolower(as.character(res$GeneSym))
  highlight_norm <- tolower(highlight_symbols)

  # Base categories for background color
  res$Significance <- "Middle"
  res$Significance[res$logFC >  0.585 & res$P.Value < 0.05] <- "Up"
  res$Significance[res$logFC < -0.585 & res$P.Value < 0.05] <- "Down"

  # Mark highlights
  res$Highlight <- res$.sym_norm %in% highlight_norm

  ggplot(res, aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(P.Value), color = Significance)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
    # overlay highlighted points on top in a single accent color
    geom_point(
      data = subset(res, Highlight),
      aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(P.Value)),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = 2.6,
      color = highlight_color,
      alpha = 0.95
    ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-0.585, 0.585), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Up"="red", "Down"="blue", "Middle"="grey")) +
    labs(title = title_text,
         x = "log2 Fold Change",
         y = "-log10 P-value") +
    xlim(-5, 5) +
    ylim(0, 6) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
}

## === quanTIseq volcano plots (WITH purity, highlighted set) ===
plot_volcano_with_qs(res_qs_with_AntiPD1_vs_Vehicle,
                     "Volcano: Anti-PD-1 vs Vehicle (quanTIseq, with purity)",
                     highlight_symbols = antiPD1_positive_genes)

plot_volcano_with_qs(res_qs_with_EPAT,
                     "Volcano: EPAT vs Vehicle (quanTIseq, with purity)",
                     highlight_symbols = antiPD1_positive_genes)

plot_volcano_with_qs(res_qs_with_Comb,

plot_volcano_with_qs(res_qs_with_Combo_vs_EPAT,
```

```{r}
# --- packages ---
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(KEGGREST)
  library(org.Mm.eg.db)
  library(AnnotationDbi)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
  library(rlang)
})

# ===== 1) Define pathways =====
kegg_paths <- c(
  Hematopoietic_cell_lineage      = "mmu04640",
  Cytokine_cytokine_receptor_int  = "mmu04060",
  Efferocytosis                   = "mmu04148",
  Fluid_shear_stress_atheroscl    = "mmu05418",
  Osteoclast_differentiation      = "mmu04380",
  Pertussis                       = "mmu05133",
  Systemic_lupus_erythematosus    = "mmu05322",
  Control_Spliceosome                        = "mmu03010",  # housekeeping
  Control_Protein_export       = "mmu00190",  # mitochondria/ETC
  Control_Purine_metabolism  = "mmu00020"
)

# ===== 2) Helper: KEGG mmu pathway -> Entrez -> Ensembl (ALL mappings) =====
kegg_path_to_ensembl <- function(path_id) {
  x <- KEGGREST::keggLink("mmu", paste0("path:", path_id))   # VALUES are "mmu:#####"
  entrez <- sub("^mmu:", "", unname(x))                      # <-- use VALUES, strip "mmu:"
  if (!length(entrez)) return(tibble(ENTREZID=character(), ENSEMBL=character(), SYMBOL=character()))

  valid_entrez <- intersect(entrez, keys(org.Mm.eg.db, keytype = "ENTREZID"))
  if (!length(valid_entrez)) return(tibble(ENTREZID=character(), ENSEMBL=character(), SYMBOL=character()))

  res <- AnnotationDbi::select(
    org.Mm.eg.db,
    keys = valid_entrez,
    keytype = "ENTREZID",
    columns = c("ENSEMBL", "SYMBOL")
  )
  res <- res[!is.na(res$ENSEMBL) & nzchar(res$ENSEMBL), , drop = FALSE]
  unique(as_tibble(res))
}

# Pull gene sets for all 7 pathways
path2genes <- lapply(kegg_paths, kegg_path_to_ensembl)

# ===== 3) Normalise your res_with_Comb table =====
# Expectation: res_with_Comb exists with Ensembl IDs as rownames OR a column named "ENSEMBL".
if (!"ENSEMBL" %in% names(res_with_Comb)) {
  res_with_Comb <- res_with_Comb %>% rownames_to_column(var = "ENSEMBL")
}
# Clean Ensembl version suffixes if present
res_with_Comb <- res_with_Comb %>% mutate(ENSEMBL = sub("\\.\\d+$", "", ENSEMBL))

# Ensure required columns
stopifnot(all(c("ENSEMBL", "logFC") %in% names(res_with_Comb)))

# ===== 4) For each pathway: intersect, compute per-gene |logFC|, then 1 summary per pathway =====
out_dir <- "kegg_forest_plots"
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Collect per-gene abs(logFC) rows (for export)
per_gene_abs <- list()

summary_rows <- lapply(names(path2genes), function(nm) {
  kegg_id <- kegg_paths[[nm]]
  mapping <- path2genes[[nm]] %>% distinct(ENSEMBL, SYMBOL, ENTREZID)
  if (nrow(mapping) == 0) {
    return(tibble(Pathway = nm, KEGG_ID = kegg_id, n_genes = 0,
                  mean_abs_logFC = NA_real_, CI_low = NA_real_, CI_high = NA_real_))
  }

  joined <- inner_join(mapping, res_with_Comb, by = "ENSEMBL") %>%
            distinct(ENSEMBL, .keep_all = TRUE)

  if (!nrow(joined)) {
    return(tibble(Pathway = nm, KEGG_ID = kegg_id, n_genes = 0,
                  mean_abs_logFC = NA_real_, CI_low = NA_real_, CI_high = NA_real_))
  }

  # Per-gene absolute logFC
  joined <- joined %>% mutate(abs_logFC = abs(logFC))
  per_gene_abs[[nm]] <- joined %>% mutate(Pathway = nm, KEGG_ID = kegg_id)

  # Pathway-level ONE value = mean(|logFC|)
  n  <- sum(!is.na(joined$abs_logFC))
  m  <- mean(joined$abs_logFC, na.rm = TRUE)
  s  <- stats::sd(joined$abs_logFC, na.rm = TRUE)
  se <- ifelse(n > 0, s / sqrt(n), NA_real_)
  ci_low  <- m - 1.96 * se
  ci_high <- m + 1.96 * se

  tibble(Pathway = nm, KEGG_ID = kegg_id, n_genes = n,
         mean_abs_logFC = m, CI_low = ci_low, CI_high = ci_high)
})

summary_df <- bind_rows(summary_rows)


```


```{r}

# ===== 5) Save per-gene and per-pathway outputs =====
per_gene_abs_df <- bind_rows(per_gene_abs)
if (nrow(per_gene_abs_df) > 0) {
  write_csv(per_gene_abs_df %>%
              select(Pathway, KEGG_ID, ENSEMBL, SYMBOL, ENTREZID, logFC, abs_logFC, everything()),
            file.path(out_dir, "per_gene_abs_logFC_by_pathway.csv"))
}

out_csv <- file.path(out_dir, "per_pathway_mean_abs_logFC.csv")
write_csv(summary_df, out_csv)

# ===== 6) Forest plot: one point per pathway showing mean(|logFC|) ± 95% CI =====
plot_df <- summary_df %>%
  arrange(mean_abs_logFC) %>%
  mutate(PathwayLabel = str_replace(Pathway, "\\s*\\(mmu\\d+\\)", ""),
         PathwayLabel = factor(PathwayLabel, levels = PathwayLabel))


p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = mean_abs_logFC, y = PathwayLabel)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = CI_low, xmax = CI_high), height = 0.2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    title = "Average absolute log2 fold change for each pathway",
    x = "absolute log2 Fold Change",
    y = NULL,
    #caption = "CI = mean ± 1.96·(sd(|logFC|)/√n) across overlapping pathway genes"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

out_png <- file.path(out_dir, "per_pathway_forest_mean_abs_logFC.png")
ggsave(out_png, p, width = 8, height = 4.5, dpi = 300)

cat("Wrote per-gene CSV: ", normalizePath(file.path(out_dir, "per_gene_abs_logFC_by_pathway.csv")), "\n")
cat("Wrote per-pathway CSV:", normalizePath(out_csv), "\n")
cat("Saved forest plot:   ", normalizePath(out_png), "\n")
```

```{r}
# --- packages ---
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(KEGGREST)
  library(org.Mm.eg.db)
  library(AnnotationDbi)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
})

# ===== 1) Define immune-related pathways =====
immune_paths <- c(
  Hematopoietic_cell_lineage      = "mmu04640",
  Cytokine_cytokine_receptor_int  = "mmu04060",
  Efferocytosis                   = "mmu04148",
  Fluid_shear_stress_atheroscl    = "mmu05418",
  Osteoclast_differentiation      = "mmu04380",
  Pertussis                       = "mmu05133",
  Systemic_lupus_erythematosus    = "mmu05322"
)

# ===== 2) Helper: KEGG mmu pathway -> Entrez -> Ensembl =====
kegg_path_to_ensembl <- function(path_id) {
  x <- KEGGREST::keggLink("mmu", paste0("path:", path_id))
  entrez <- sub("^mmu:", "", unname(x))
  valid_entrez <- intersect(entrez, keys(org.Mm.eg.db, keytype = "ENTREZID"))
  if (!length(valid_entrez)) return(tibble(ENTREZID=character(), ENSEMBL=character(), SYMBOL=character()))
  res <- AnnotationDbi::select(
    org.Mm.eg.db,
    keys = valid_entrez,
    keytype = "ENTREZID",
    columns = c("ENSEMBL", "SYMBOL")
  )
  res <- res[!is.na(res$ENSEMBL) & nzchar(res$ENSEMBL), , drop = FALSE]
  unique(as_tibble(res))
}

# ===== 3) Collect all immune-pathway genes =====
immune_path2genes <- lapply(immune_paths, kegg_path_to_ensembl)
immune_genes_all <- unique(unlist(lapply(immune_path2genes, `[[`, "ENSEMBL")))

# ===== 4) Prepare res_with_Comb =====
if (!"ENSEMBL" %in% names(res_with_Comb)) {
  res_with_Comb <- res_with_Comb %>% rownames_to_column(var = "ENSEMBL")
}
res_with_Comb <- res_with_Comb %>% mutate(ENSEMBL = sub("\\.\\d+$", "", ENSEMBL))

# ===== 5) Compute absolute logFC and get top 50 =====
top50 <- res_with_Comb %>%
  mutate(abs_logFC = abs(logFC)) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs_logFC)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 50)

# ===== 6) Map Ensembl to gene symbols for readability =====
mapped <- AnnotationDbi::select(
  org.Mm.eg.db,
  keys = top50$ENSEMBL,
  keytype = "ENSEMBL",
  columns = c("SYMBOL")
)
top50 <- top50 %>% left_join(mapped, by = "ENSEMBL")

# ===== 7) Identify which top 50 genes are NOT in any immune pathway =====
top50$in_immune_pathway <- top50$ENSEMBL %in% immune_genes_all
not_in_immune <- top50 %>% filter(!in_immune_pathway)

# ===== 8) Print results =====
cat("\n=== Top 50 genes by |logFC| not in immune-related KEGG pathways ===\n")
not_in_immune %>%
  dplyr::select(ENSEMBL, SYMBOL, logFC, abs_logFC) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(abs_logFC)) %>%
  print(n = Inf)

cat("\nNumber of non-immune genes in top 50:", nrow(not_in_immune), "\n")



```
